# Architecture pack

This pack holds the architecture model in slices for agents. areas/<name>.md holds one area: its elements, decisions, contracts, open questions and known-gap entries, and the capabilities that pass through it. capabilities/<name>.md holds one capability: its steps, the elements they touch, and the decisions and contracts that name it. This file holds the index and the facts outside any area. A pack file in brackets after an id names the file that holds that id in full. model.json holds the whole export.
